content: I have some lean code using the theorem inners_sum_eq_zero_of_const_inner_on_open. I tried to find this theorem in the Mathlib docs now, but I can't find it. And I'm pretty sure that the lean code I have uses a pretty recent Mathlib version (probably not older than two weeks from the latest version). Could it be that this theorem name was changed very recently? How can I find it?

Searching for inners_sum_eq_zero_of_const_inner_on_open, indeed this theorem does not seem to exist on current mathlib. However, when a theorem is renamed (or removed), we add a marker ("deprecated alias") from the old to the new name... and you should still be able to find that marker.
If I'm reading github right, I think you are the one adding it :) https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36731
Are you really sure that lemma existed in mathlib?

Also worth bookmarking: https://mathlib-changelog.org/v4
(not useful in this case because the theorem was probably never in mathlib)
I checked the changelog first before searching GitHub but it was extremely slow for me on Firefox so I gave up before the page loaded. Let's see why.

Julian Berman said:

If I'm reading github right, I think you are the one adding it :) https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/36731

Oh, that's so funny :joy: , thank you very much and sorry for that, I'm just returning to working on this project after a break of a few weeks, so I forgot about it.
